# `court_opinion_clusters`

One row per court *decision* ("opinion cluster" in CourtListener's model), ingested from the quarterly bulk `opinion-clusters` dump by `build_court_opinion_clusters` and topped up between dumps from the keyless `/search/?type=o` API. A cluster is the case-level record that sibling opinions hang off, and it is the join the corpus was missing: `cl_docket_id` matches `court_dockets.cl_docket_id`, so a decision can be traced back to the APA challenge that produced it and onward to the agency named in the docket. Bulk is not an optimization here — the v4 `/clusters/` endpoint answers 401 without an API token, so the published dump is the only keyless source. `ingest_source` records which of the two paths produced a row, because the search surface is narrower than the dump and leaves the long prose fields null rather than inventing them. Primary / dedup key is `cluster_id`. All columns are stored as VARCHAR.

- **Parquet file:** `court_opinion_clusters.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cluster_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener opinion-cluster id. Primary key / dedup key. Joins `court_opinion_bodies.cluster_id`. |
| `cl_docket_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener docket id this decision was issued under. Joins `court_dockets.cl_docket_id`. Null for decisions whose docket is not in CourtListener. |
| `case_name` | `VARCHAR` | Case caption as published (for example `Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. NRDC`). |
| `case_name_short` | `VARCHAR` | Abbreviated caption, when the publisher supplies one. |
| `case_name_full` | `VARCHAR` | Full caption including every named party. |
| `date_filed` | `VARCHAR` | Date the decision was filed (ISO 8601). |
| `date_filed_is_approximate` | `VARCHAR` | `t` when the publisher marked the filing date as approximate, else `f`. |
| `judges` | `VARCHAR` | Judge or panel names as a single publisher-supplied string. |
| `nature_of_suit` | `VARCHAR` | Nature-of-suit text carried on the decision, when present. Distinct from the docket's numeric code. |
| `precedential_status` | `VARCHAR` | Publication status, for example `Published`, `Unpublished`, `Errata`. |
| `citation_count` | `VARCHAR` | Number of later decisions citing this one, as counted by CourtListener. |
| `scdb_id` | `VARCHAR` | Supreme Court Database identifier, for decisions matched to SCDB. |
| `scdb_decision_direction` | `VARCHAR` | SCDB-coded ideological direction of the decision, when matched. |
| `scdb_votes_majority` | `VARCHAR` | SCDB majority vote count, when matched. |
| `scdb_votes_minority` | `VARCHAR` | SCDB minority vote count, when matched. |
| `source` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener source code recording which upstream feed supplied the record. |
| `procedural_history` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-supplied procedural history prose. |
| `attorneys` | `VARCHAR` | Attorneys of record as a single publisher-supplied string. |
| `posture` | `VARCHAR` | Procedural posture prose, when supplied. |
| `syllabus` | `VARCHAR` | Official syllabus / headnote summary, when the reporter published one. |
| `headnotes` | `VARCHAR` | Reporter headnotes, when published. |
| `summary` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-supplied case summary. |
| `disposition` | `VARCHAR` | Disposition prose (for example `Affirmed`, `Reversed and remanded`). |
| `history` | `VARCHAR` | Subsequent-history prose, when supplied. |
| `other_dates` | `VARCHAR` | Free-text additional dates supplied by the reporter. |
| `cross_reference` | `VARCHAR` | Cross-reference prose supplied by the reporter. |
| `correction` | `VARCHAR` | Correction notice text, when the decision was corrected. |
| `arguments` | `VARCHAR` | Argument-section text, for decisions whose reporter published one. |
| `headmatter` | `VARCHAR` | Reporter headmatter block preceding the opinion text. |
| `blocked` | `VARCHAR` | `t` when CourtListener has blocked the decision from search-engine indexing. |
| `date_blocked` | `VARCHAR` | Date the decision was blocked, when it was. |
| `slug` | `VARCHAR` | URL slug component used on courtlistener.com. |
| `absolute_url` | `VARCHAR` | Absolute URL of the decision on courtlistener.com. |
| `date_created` | `VARCHAR` | Timestamp CourtListener first created the cluster record. |
| `date_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Timestamp the cluster record was last modified upstream. |
| `ingest_source` | `VARCHAR` | Which path produced the row: `bulk` (quarterly dump) or `search` (keyless catch-up API, narrower column set). |
